description: Image with Critical or High Severity Vulnerabilities
rationale: A scan finding only becomes a fix when somebody acts on it, and an image sitting in the registry with critical or high severity vulnerabilities is one that anything pulling it inherits. Unlike a host, a container is not patched in place: the finding stays true for as long as the image exists, and every task, pod or function started from it starts vulnerable. These are also the findings that come with a known exploitation path, which is what separates them from the medium and low counts a scan always returns.
remediation: Rebuild the image on an updated base image and with updated dependencies, push it, and expire the affected version so that nothing can still pull it
